As a packer 3 shifts, you will work full-time in a dynamic production environment where you are responsible for packing and inspecting plastic packaging. You work in a 3-shift system, which means you work at various times and receive an extra shift allowance. There are plenty of opportunities for growth, for example towards becoming an operator or forklift driver, and the company offers the prospect of permanent employment if you perform well.

You start your working day by operating a machine that produces plastic trays. At the end of the production line, you stack these trays, carefully check their quality, and pack them into cardboard boxes. You ensure the packaged products are neatly placed on a pallet. If you notice any irregularities, you report this immediately so the machine can be adjusted. During breaks, you coordinate with colleagues to ensure the work continues smoothly.

Do you want a stable job with security and room for growth? Then apply quickly as a packer 3 shifts and take your chance for a great future at a leading packaging manufacturer.

- 

- You are available full-time

- You have no problem working in a 3-shift system

- You can take responsibility for your own machine

- You are motivated to work for the long term

- Knowledge of the English language is a plus

In this role, you are the guardian of quality for highly specialized processes within an international high-tech company. The company develops, repairs, and inspects critical components for the aerospace, energy, and defense industries. Together with your team, you work every day to achieve the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your attention to detail and expertise in handling valuable and delicate components make you an essential partner for our customers. In addition, you participate in 5S projects aimed at making work processes safer and more efficient.

You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule: one week in the day shift (five days) and the next week in the evening shift (four days).

- Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections to ensure quality and detect discontinuities or defects using methods such as eddy current testing and ultrasonic testing
- Experience with: Visual inspections, dimensional inspections, receiving inspections and reading and interpreting technical drawings
- Knowledge of and experience with measuring instruments such as calipers and micrometers
- Good command of the English language
